title: Are Companies Too Focused on Replacing People with AI Instead of Investing in Them?
description:
Were organizations too focused on replacing people instead of investing in them?

That’s the question we’re asking and answering at the “AI, People, and the Future of Work” webinar on June 24th, hosted by Rocky Phoenix AI 🐦‍🔥

Come and join us - register at https://www.eventbrite.com/e/ai-people-and-the-future-of-work-tickets-1991611774430?aff=oddtdtcreator 🔗
